text:
Ana R: FYI 0min sync with vendor: they want to sell HW appliances and include a 12mo Redwood reserved capacity commitment as a purchase incentive. they asked for a private offer flow + renewal uplift. can we brainstorm structure and ops requirements?
Derek: short answer: yes. but need to decide (A) committed tiers (buckets vs $ commit), (B) how to surface monthly usage for their finance/audit, (C) fallback if infra delays. timeline?
Ana R: target joint availability in ~7 weeks. they'd like a saleable SKU for partners to quote.
Min: ops flags 1) provisioning lead time 30 days for Dedicated pools, 2) private offers require marketplace form + legal review (10bd), 3) pricing ops needs explicit token pricing and renewal credit rules. we can compress to hit 7 weeks if approvals run in parallel.
Carlos: partner proposal: HW sold at 15% off MAP, plus Redwood 1-yr reserved credits at 25% off list (prepaid). renewal incentive: if they renew >=85% of prior year committed spend, give an extra 7% credit applied to renewal. also allow additive "top-up" purchases mid-year. thoughts?
Derek: prefer simplicity: two committed tiers (Bronze/Silver) with token buckets to make quoting predictable for resellers. Bronze=500k tokens, Silver=2M tokens. Price examples required for AE pack.
Ana R: partner needs tiered pricing in the private offer metadata. also asks for a CSV monthly usage dump for auditors and a billing reconciliation report. is that feasible?
Min: yes. we can enable a monthly usage export (CSV) for the customer org, and add a reconciliation object in the procurement flow. caveat: exports will show token-level aggregate only, no raw prompts.
Carlos: important for SI partners: need the private offer to be transferrable to their resale channel (assignment). can Redwood permit an SI attach clause?
Derek: we can support partner-managed resell if contract explicitly allows assignment and we create a reseller mapping in the offer metadata. legal will need to sign.
PartnerBot: heads up: marketplace form required: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/forms - complete by 2026-04-21 to keep timeline.
Ana R: resiliency question 0ops: if Dedicated pool can't provision on time, partner expects fallback so customers still get value day 1. propose auto-route traffic to hosted models for first 60 days, with prorated credits until Dedicated online.
Min: agree. we'll add a degrade-to-hosted policy with automatic routing + transparent SLA credits. need to add this to the private offer terms and the SKU description.
Carlos: renewal cadence 0sales: send automated reminders at 120/60/30 days, surface recommended upsell of +20% commit for an extra 5% renewal discount. AE playbook should include HW attach upsell script.
Derek: pricing ops needs final token $s. quick draft numbers: Bronze=500k @ $0.0009/token (post-bundle), Silver=2M @ $0.0007/token, year1 discount 25%. apply 7% renewal credit if renewal >=85% commit. open to adjustments.
Ana R: okay I'll put together a one-pager with SKU names, token math examples, integration checklist (marketplace form, legal, provisioning, partner resale mapping, CSV export).
Min: action items: Min to provision fallback policy + SKU meta; Derek to run numbers with Priya (pricing lead); Carlos to confirm partner resale language; Ana to submit marketplace form by 2026-04-21; PartnerBot to remind ops triggers.
Carlos: partner also asked for joint announcement collateral and co-branded kickoff webinar. can marketing support?
Ana R: I'll loop in marketing after we lock the offer. tentative webinar: week after launch.
Derek: small note: include an SLO in the offer: 99.5% availability or pro-rata credits, and documented outage playbook for first 90 days.
Ana R: perfect. we'll reconvene next Tue to finalize marketplace payload. thanks everyone :rocket:
